+def test_urlopen_keep_trying_headers_and_encoding(monkeypatch):
+    response = requests.Response()
+    response.status_code = 200
+    response.headers['Content-Type'] = 'text/xml'
+    response._content = '<record>é</record>'.encode('utf-8')
+    response.encoding = 'ISO-8859-1'
+    calls = []
+
+    def get(url, **kwargs):
+        calls.append((url, kwargs))
+        return response
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(get_ia.requests, 'get', get)
+    result = get_ia.urlopen_keep_trying('https://example.org/record',
+                                        headers={'Range': 'bytes=0-10'}, timeout=5)
+    assert calls == [('https://example.org/record',
+                      {'headers': {'Range': 'bytes=0-10'}, 'timeout': 5})]
+    assert result.content == response._content
+    assert result.text == '<record>é</record>'
+
+
+def test_urlopen_keep_trying_preserves_declared_charset(monkeypatch):
+    response = requests.Response()
+    response.status_code = 200
+    response.headers['Content-Type'] = 'text/xml; charset=iso-8859-1'
+    response._content = '<record>é</record>'.encode('iso-8859-1')
+    response.encoding = 'iso-8859-1'
+    monkeypatch.setattr(get_ia.requests, 'get', lambda *args, **kwargs: response)
+
+    result = get_ia.urlopen_keep_trying('https://example.org/record')
+    assert result.encoding == 'iso-8859-1'
+    assert result.text == '<record>é</record>'
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('status, attempts', [(403, 1), (404, 1), (416, 1), (500, 3)])
+def test_urlopen_keep_trying_http_errors(monkeypatch, status, attempts):
+    response = requests.Response()
+    response.status_code = status
+    calls = []
+    def get(*args, **kwargs):
+        calls.append(args)
+        return response
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(get_ia.requests, 'get', get)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(get_ia, 'sleep', lambda seconds: None)
+
+    if status == 500:
+        assert get_ia.urlopen_keep_trying('https://example.org/record') is None
+    else:
+        with pytest.raises(requests.exceptions.HTTPError) as error:
+            get_ia.urlopen_keep_trying('https://example.org/record')
+        assert error.value.response.status_code == status
+    assert len(calls) == attempts
+
